description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score (y-axis) and Average Lagging (AL) (x-axis) for four different training strategies in simultaneous machine translation, as presented in the paper “Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine Translation.” The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” ranges from 1 to 8 with integer tick marks at 2, 4, 6, and 8, indicating discrete AL values tested. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” spans from 20 to 30 with major gridlines at 22, 24, 26, 28, and 30, representing translation quality scores. Four distinct lines are plotted: “Consistency-CE” (light purple, circle markers, dashed line) starts at BLEU ≈20.2 at AL=1 and rises to ≈29.2 at AL=8; “Inconsistency-CE” (dark purple, square markers, dash-dot line) begins at ≈22.3 at AL=1 and reaches ≈29.7 at AL=8; “Inconsistency-CE-MP” (blue, square markers, dashed line) starts at ≈22.2 at AL=1 and ends at ≈29.3 at AL=8; and “Consistency-Bi” (red, star markers, solid line) begins at ≈24.8 at AL=1 and climbs to ≈30.2 at AL=8. All lines show a generally increasing trend in BLEU as AL increases, with “Consistency-Bi” consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across all AL values. A gray square legend entry is present but not associated with any plotted line.
